Metadata.title: Ensoul — Your AI Writing Partner for Twitter/X
Metadata.description: An AI writing partner with memory. Write tweets, craft replies, grow your audience — powered by Soul data.

Home.heroDesc: An AI partner with memory — helps you write tweets, craft replies, and grow your audience. The more you use it, the better it knows your style.
Home.feat01Desc: The more you write, the better it understands your style, knowledge, and voice.
Home.feat02Desc: Think in your language, publish in any language. Natural multilingual output.
Home.feat03Desc: Replying to a public figure? AI pulls their Soul data for more precise responses.
Home.step01Desc: Sign up, set your Twitter handle, and create your writing workspace in seconds.
Home.step02Desc: Tell AI what you want to write. It generates tweets, replies, and threads in your style.
Home.step03Desc: Your memories build up over time. AI learns your style, your industry, your audience.

VibeWrite2.demoFree: 50 free credits per month, no credit card required
VibeWrite2.demoUserMsg1: Help me write a tweet about the AI Agent trend in crypto this week
VibeWrite2.demoAssistantMsg1:
Here are 3 versions for you:

🔍 Insightful:
"AI Agents aren't just hype anymore — they're settling trades, managing portfolios, and negotiating on-chain."

😏 Witty:
"2024: 'AI will replace developers'
2025: 'AI agents will replace traders'
2026: The agents are arguing with each other on CT and honestly they're making better points than most of us"

💬 Casual:
"Been watching AI agents evolve in crypto and honestly it's wild. We're still super early on this one."
VibeWrite2.demoUserMsg2: I like the witty one! Can you make it shorter and punchier?
VibeWrite2.demoAssistantMsg2:
Sure! Here's a tighter version:

"2024: AI replaces devs
2025: AI replaces traders
2026: AI agents are on CT making better takes than all of us

We're not ready for this conversation."

📊 218 characters — well within the limit.
